config.threshold_rule: per fold: lower theta from +inf over the exact unique scores of the threshold set until its FA/h on clean negatives first exceeds the target; keep the lowest theta before that (geometric top-down scan + bisection)
config.threshold_set_rule: all non-test videos of each fold (fold-agnostic scores only)
config.ci_note: 95 % percentile cluster bootstrap over test videos (or groups). Thresholds are held fixed across resamples and the threshold-selection videos are not resampled, so the CIs of thresholded metrics omit threshold-selection noise (see val_clean_negative_hours_per_fold: one alarm = 1 / hours FA/h).

clean_time_matched.definition: clean negatives re-weighted to the positives' (source kind x seconds-since-start) distribution (5 s bins up to 120 s); positives without comparable negatives dropped

definition.clean: positives: pre-violence unmasked ticks with 30 < tte <= 60 (first segment only); negatives: clean-negative ticks with >= 60 s of footage left
definition.secondary: negatives: pre-violence unmasked ticks of any universe video with no onset within 120 s
definition.clean_uncensored: as clean, without the 60 s right-censoring of clean negatives
definition.clean_all_segments: spec literal: positives of every segment (also after earlier violence)

calibration.target: P(onset within 30 s) on unmasked, uncensored ticks

random_reference_success30.formula: 1 - exp(-FAR * W), FAR = test FA/h on clean negatives. Assumes alarm times independent of position in the clip; compare with position_null_success30 too

detection.definition: any active alarm tick in [max(t0 - 120, clear_start), e], all events

threshold_aware_ci.note: validation videos resampled and theta re-chosen per replicate; test videos resampled jointly
